items.title: Pete Levin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: Most recently it was with Annie Lennox a few years ago when she was doing a promo tour and we did “Saturday Night Live.”

ctx.x: It’s a kind of a one-shot.

There are a lot of cable channels, very successful ones, who don’t, they’re not signatory to anything, the musicians’ unions, actors unions, ASCAP, BMI, they just don’t sign the contracts. And all this stuff has been taken for granted over to the big networks, they all do, they just don’t do it. They realize they can get music and performances for nothing. Just don’t agree to anything and you’ve got it. Another typical example is I’ve done “Saturday Night Live” a couple of times with the guest music artist. Most…
As a member of her band.
